items.markdown:
Lab-grown diamonds are `real diamonds created in a controlled laboratory using advanced technology that replicates the natural conditions of the Earth`.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/lab-grown-diamonds/)[[2]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made)[[3]](https://www.miadonna.com/pages/what-are-lab-grown-diamonds)

They share the exact same chemical composition, crystal structure, and optical brilliance as mined diamonds. Two main methods are used to grow them: **High Pressure High Temperature (HPHT)** and **Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD)**.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qNeqKdCeNQ&t=5)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/lab-grown-vs-natural-diamond/)

### The Two Growth Methods

- **HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature):** This method places a small diamond seed and a carbon source (like graphite) inside a specialized press. The system heats the material to roughly 2,700°F (1,300–1,600°C) and applies crushing pressures exceeding 700,000 to 870,000 pounds per square inch. The carbon melts and crystallizes onto the seed over a few weeks.[[1]](https://www.gia.edu/hpht-and-cvd-diamond-growth-processes)[[2]](https://www.linkedin.com/videos/kenkuang_can-you-believe-this-machine-can-grow-diamonds-activity-7375582110914502657-YZBm)
- **CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition):** This method places a diamond seed in a sealed vacuum chamber filled with carbon-rich gases like methane and hydrogen. Microwaves or lasers turn the gas into a glowing plasma. The plasma breaks down the gas, and carbon atoms drop layer by layer onto the seed to form a rough diamond over several weeks.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2hrXBwf8ZhQ)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/cullenjewellery/videos/making-of-a-lab-diamond/1370638208412165/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SPAMTs6Ug20)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qNeqKdCeNQ&t=5)[[5]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/lab-grown-vs-natural-diamond/)

### Key Facts About Lab Diamonds

- **Authenticity:** They are 100% real diamonds and score a 10 on the Mohs hardness scale. Standard gemological tools cannot tell them apart without specialized equipment.[[1]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made)
- **Timeframe:** While natural diamonds take billions of years to form underground, lab diamonds take only two to four weeks.[[1]](https://www.linkedin.com/videos/kenkuang_can-you-believe-this-machine-can-grow-diamonds-activity-7375582110914502657-YZBm)[[2]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made)
- **Cost:** Lab-grown diamonds are typically much more affordable than mined diamonds because the production process requires less time and labor.[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/pages/what-are-lab-grown-diamonds)[[2]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made)
